proposal.literary_form: anthology superscription and purpose prologue
proposal.deciding_marker: The superscription opens the anthology; infinitival purpose clauses culminate in the fear-of-YHWH thesis at 1:7 before the first 'my son' address.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Prov.1.1 alone would detach the title from its purpose statement.
proposal.risk: Low: explicit title-purpose closure; function, not chapter number, decides the seam.

proposal.literary_form: parental instruction against a violent peer invitation
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son' opens direct instruction; the quoted enticement, prohibition, bird/net comparison, and consequence close together at 1:19.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting the sinners' quotation from the parental consequence would fragment one warning.
proposal.risk: Low: complete address and consequence.

proposal.literary_form: personified Wisdom's public summons and refusal oracle
proposal.deciding_marker: Wisdom becomes the named public speaker at 1:20; direct address, rejected call, reversal, and the secure-hearer contrast close at 1:33.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A break at 1:23 or 1:28 would sever summons from judicial consequence.
proposal.risk: Low: speaker and full speech frame are explicit; no ontology is decided.

proposal.literary_form: single conditional parental instruction on seeking wisdom
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son, if' governs the chapter-length protasis; repeated 'then' results unfold as deliverance from two paths and conclude with the land contrast.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting at 2:9, 2:12, or 2:16 would detach coordinated results from their governing condition.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident hold: positive conditional syntax and land closure support the unit, but the exact scope of the two deliverance movements merits external review.

proposal.literary_form: parental instruction chain on teaching, trust, honor, and discipline
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son' opens; paired imperatives and motive clauses move through trust and firstfruits to a final 'my son' discipline frame closed by the father-son comparison.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 3:5-6 or 3:9-10 would extract famous maxims from their instruction chain.
proposal.risk: Medium: the sequence is linked rhetorically, though its sub-admonitions are partly detachable.

proposal.literary_form: wisdom beatitude and creation hymn
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Happy is the man' shifts to beatitude; value comparisons and tree-of-life imagery lead into YHWH's wisdom in creation, closing with the dew line.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating 3:19-20 would obscure the creation-grounded climax of the wisdom praise.
proposal.risk: Low: marked beatitude and praise movement.

proposal.literary_form: parental instruction on safeguarded conduct toward neighbors
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son' reopens direct address; security promises lead to a do-not catalogue, then a wicked/righteous and curse/blessing closure.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting at 3:27 would detach social prohibitions from their wisdom-security frame.
proposal.risk: Medium: the neighbor catalogue may be internally grouped, so the larger complete instruction is retained.

proposal.literary_form: intergenerational paternal instruction praising Wisdom
proposal.deciding_marker: Plural 'sons' and 'listen' open a teaching frame; the father's remembered instruction and imperative to acquire Wisdom close with Wisdom's garland/crown promise.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A seam at 4:3 would separate the remembered father from the teaching he transmits.
proposal.risk: Low: explicit audience, tradition frame, and closing promise.

proposal.literary_form: two-ways parental instruction
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Listen, my son' opens; guidance on wisdom's path is contrasted with the wicked path, ending in light/darkness antithesis.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Breaking at 4:14 would sever the opposed paths that form the instruction.
proposal.risk: Low: vocative and sustained two-path contrast.

proposal.literary_form: body-and-path parental exhortation
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son, attend' reopens address; ear, eyes, heart, mouth, eyelids, feet, and path imperatives form a body catalogue closed by the command not to turn.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 4:23 would detach the heart maxim from its governing body/path catalogue.
proposal.risk: Low: renewed vocative and coordinated body imagery.

proposal.literary_form: complete parental warning and counter-instruction concerning illicit desire
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son' opens attention; danger, path consequences, direct avoidance, cistern/wife counter-image, and final YHWH-path consequence form one arc.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting at 5:15 would detach the positive counter-instruction from the warning it answers.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident hold: a complete warning-counterinstruction arc is visible, but inner movement seams are plausible.

proposal.literary_form: brief parental rescue instruction about surety
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son, if' opens a conditional predicament; urgent imperatives culminate in gazelle/bird escape images.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Joining the ant saying would erase the completed surety-and-escape frame.
proposal.risk: Low: explicit condition and rescue closure.

proposal.literary_form: sluggard address and ant observation
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Go to the ant, you sluggard' changes addressee and example; rhetorical questions culminate in the paired poverty simile.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating ant observation from the sleep-and-poverty application would fragment the analogy.
proposal.risk: Low: named addressee and completed observation/application.

proposal.literary_form: troublemaker portrait and escalating abomination list
proposal.deciding_marker: 'A worthless person' opens a body-part portrait; sudden calamity leads into the six/seven catalogue, whose last item returns to social discord.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting at 6:16 would detach the formal list from the embodied troublemaker portrait it intensifies.
proposal.risk: Medium: portrait and number list can be read separately, so their shared discord/body function should be reviewed.

proposal.literary_form: parental instruction against adultery with legal-social consequence
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son' reopens instruction; bound teaching guides the son past seduction, fire/lap and burglary comparisons lead to the jealous husband's irreversible response.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Breaking at 6:27 or 6:30 would detach comparisons from the warning's social consequence.
proposal.risk: Low: vocative, sustained danger, and consequence closure.

proposal.literary_form: parental instruction containing an observed seduction narrative
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son' opens and frames the command; the window observation, woman's speech, youth's capitulation, and renewed plural appeal close with the way-to-Sheol verdict.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Extracting 7:6-23 as a standalone story would lose its parental frame and application.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident hold: the frame-narrative-appeal arc is positive evidence, while the embedded narrative is a plausible smaller unit.

proposal.literary_form: Wisdom's public call and value invitation
proposal.deciding_marker: Rhetorical questions announce Wisdom; public-location speech addresses humanity and closes with wisdom's incomparable value.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Joining the preceding seduction appeal would blur the new public speaker and counter-invitation.
proposal.risk: Low: speaker and public summons are marked.

proposal.literary_form: Wisdom's self-description through prudence, rule, love, and wealth
proposal.deciding_marker: 'I, Wisdom' renews self-identification; first-person predicates form a coherent catalogue ending with filled treasuries.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting royal-rule statements from the surrounding first-person self-description would isolate one function.
proposal.risk: Medium: this remains part of the larger Wisdom speech.

proposal.literary_form: Wisdom's first-person primordial/creation movement
proposal.deciding_marker: The temporal 'before' sequence shifts to origins; repeated creation scenes culminate in daily delight before YHWH and humanity.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Atomizing individual creation stages would mistake parallel temporal clauses for outer seams.
proposal.risk: Medium: translation and ontology pressures are substantial; the decision is literary scope only.

proposal.literary_form: Wisdom's concluding beatitude and life/death appeal
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Now therefore, my sons' turns from self-description to conclusion; listen/blessed/finds-life versus sins-against-me/loves-death closes the speech.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Joining Wisdom's banquet at 9:1 would erase this completed conclusion and the new third-person scene.
proposal.risk: Low: conclusion formula and terminal antithesis.

proposal.literary_form: Wisdom's house-and-banquet invitation
proposal.deciding_marker: Third-person Wisdom builds, prepares, sends, and speaks; the invitation closes with the imperative to live and walk in understanding.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating preparation from invitation would fragment a single banquet scene.
proposal.risk: Low: scene, emissaries, and quoted invitation.

proposal.literary_form: responsive interlude on scoffer, wise person, and personal consequence
proposal.deciding_marker: The banquet scene pauses for second-person maxims about correction; fear-of-YHWH and 'if you are wise' consequence close before Folly's new scene.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Absorbing the interlude into either woman's invitation hides its distinct correction-response function.
proposal.risk: Medium: speaker attribution and exact relation to the invitations are ambiguous.

proposal.literary_form: Folly's rival house invitation
proposal.deciding_marker: 'The foolish woman' introduces a new seated caller; her stolen-water invitation ends with the narrator's death/Sheol disclosure.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating 9:18 would remove the narratorial reversal that closes the rival banquet.
proposal.risk: Low: new character, parallel invitation, and terminal disclosure.

proposal.literary_form: Solomonic collection opening cluster on child, wealth, diligence, and harvest
proposal.deciding_marker: The explicit 'Proverbs of Solomon' superscription opens; child/parent consequences move through profit and diligence to the wise/shameful harvest son.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Prov.10.1 alone would isolate the superscription-bearing saying and one-verse units would atomize the opening son/work chain.
proposal.risk: High seam uncertainty: catchword and role links are real but do not authorize collection history.

proposal.literary_form: contrast cluster on blessing, memory, mouth, and violence
proposal.deciding_marker: Blessing and wicked-mouth violence recur at both edges; righteous memory and wise reception occupy the center.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One proverb per chunk would lose the mouth/violence envelope.
proposal.risk: High: aphoristic catchword clustering is contestable; retain named-collection parent.

proposal.literary_form: speech-and-social consequence cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Hatred/love opens; lips, slander, concealment, speech abundance, and righteous lips/tongue repeatedly govern the sequence.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating each bicola would erase the dense lips/speech chain.
proposal.risk: High: verses 15-16 broaden to wealth/wages within the chain.

proposal.literary_form: YHWH-outcome and durable-righteousness cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: YHWH's blessing opens; wicked desire/fear and storm passing contrast with the righteous person's durable hope, days, and unshaken land status.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A chapter-end seam would interrupt the mouth/YHWH transition continued in the next unit.
proposal.risk: High: thematic rather than formal closure.

proposal.literary_form: cross-chapter mouth-and-integrity bridge
proposal.deciding_marker: Righteous/wicked mouth contrasts at 10:31-32 turn to YHWH's evaluation of false versus just measures at 11:1, bridging speech and integrity across the chapter seam.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Ending at 10:32 would privilege chapter numbering despite the continuing moral-evaluation cadence.
proposal.risk: High: 11:1 may open the next humility/integrity cluster; cross-chapter grouping is provisional.

proposal.literary_form: humility, integrity, and deliverance contrast cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Pride/humility opens; integrity guides, wealth fails, righteousness delivers, and wicked trouble reverses onto the wicked.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One-verse segmentation would obscure repeated integrity/righteousness/deliverance terms.
proposal.risk: High: 11:1 remains a competing opening.

proposal.literary_form: speech, city, counsel, and surety social-order cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Mouth-based destruction/deliverance opens; city rejoicing, gossip/trust, counsel, and surety all concern social stability.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting city/counsel from speech would lose their shared communal-order function.
proposal.risk: High: surety may begin a new sequence.

proposal.literary_form: honor, kindness, violence, and character-result cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Honor/wealth introduces gendered character contrasts; kindness/cruelty, deceptive wages, steadfast righteousness, and the ring-in-swine image all evaluate character and outcome.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 11:22 as a memorable image would detach its character-evaluation role.
proposal.risk: High: loose anthology adjacency and translation pressure.

proposal.literary_form: desire, generosity, fruit, and recompense cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Desire/outcome opens; giving and withholding lead to blessing, trust, flourishing, fruit, and recompense in the land.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Ending before 11:31 would weaken the repeated outcome/recompense closure.
proposal.risk: High: fruit vocabulary supports but does not prove the scope.

proposal.literary_form: discipline, favor, household, and stability cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Love of correction opens; good/wicked favor, rooted righteousness, household shame/crown, and the house-standing contrast converge on stability.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Chapter-sized or one-verse chunks would miss the rooted/house-standing movement.
proposal.risk: High: thematic cluster has no explicit superscription.

proposal.literary_form: social estimation, work, compassion, and productive-root cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Praise/contempt opens; lowly productive work contrasts with pretension, cruelty, empty pursuits, and wicked desire, closing with righteous-root fruit.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating work and root images would understate the productivity motif.
proposal.risk: High: compassion vocabulary interrupts a tight work chain.

proposal.literary_form: speech, truth, counsel, and concealment cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Lip transgression opens; mouth fruit, fool/wise counsel, rash/healing words, truthful/lying lips, deceit, and prudent concealment dominate.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One proverb per unit would erase the sustained speech vocabulary.
proposal.risk: Medium-high: 12:15-16 adds counsel/anger but remains speech-response related.

proposal.literary_form: diligence, anxiety, guidance, and life-path closing cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Diligent versus lazy hand opens; anxious heart and good word, neighbor guidance, sloth/diligence, and the righteousness path culminate in life.
proposal.rejected_alternative: The chapter boundary is retained only because the life-path line provides a positive collection cadence.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: local life-path closure exists, but 13:1 may continue instruction contrasts.

proposal.literary_form: instruction, mouth, appetite, diligence, and guarding-righteousness cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Wise son/discipline opens; mouth fruit and guarding lead into appetite/diligence, lying, and righteousness guarding the way.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A seam at 13:3 would detach guarded mouth from guarded conduct.
proposal.risk: High: son formula may merely be another independent aphorism.

proposal.literary_form: wealth, ransom, light, pride, and incremental gain cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Rich/poor reversal opens; wealth as ransom, righteous light, pride contention, and diminishing versus gathered wealth share possession/outcome concerns.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One-verse units would obscure the repeated wealth/outcome vocabulary.
proposal.risk: High: light and pride sayings weaken thematic unity.

proposal.literary_form: desire fulfilled, instruction, prudence, and consequence cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Deferred versus fulfilled desire opens; command/fear, wise teaching, prudence, messenger, correction, and fulfilled desire close the inclusio.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting before 13:19 would lose the repeated desire-fulfilled frame.
proposal.risk: Medium-high: the desire inclusio is positive, while internal sayings remain aphoristic.

proposal.literary_form: companionship, inheritance, provision, discipline, and appetite cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Walking with wise/fools opens; good/wicked outcomes move through inheritance and provision to parental discipline and righteous/wicked appetite.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating child-discipline verses would detach them from household provision and outcome.
proposal.risk: High: household/result linkage is broader than a formal seam.

proposal.literary_form: house-building, speech, witness, knowledge, and guilt cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Wise/foolish woman building/demolishing a house opens; walking, mouth, ox/work, witness, fool, and guilt all test whether conduct builds or corrupts communal life.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A chapter-sized unit lacks specificity, while one-verse units erase house/work/witness interaction.
proposal.risk: High: several adjacent topics make the outer seam provisional.

proposal.literary_form: inner state, deceptive way, and social reversal cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: The heart's private bitterness/joy opens; house/tent outcomes, way-seeming-right, laughter/grief, backslider, prudent belief, anger, simplicity, and evil bowing form inner-state-to-outcome contrasts.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 14:12 would detach the deceptive-way maxim from its emotional and social consequence sequence.
proposal.risk: High: strong local echoes but no explicit boundary formula.

proposal.literary_form: neighbor, poverty, mercy, labor, wisdom, witness, and fear refuge cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Poor/rich neighbor treatment opens; mercy and labor lead through wisdom/witness to fear-of-YHWH confidence and fountain-of-life closure.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Breaking before the fear-of-YHWH pair would remove the refuge/life culmination.
proposal.risk: High: neighbor and fear motifs are linked by consequence rather than syntax.

proposal.literary_form: kingdom, patience, life, justice, and royal favor cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: A king's populous glory opens; patience/envy, oppression of poor, national righteousness, and servant/king favor close as public-order evaluations.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A raw chapter seam is rejected; the royal frame and national/king closure provide the positive rationale.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: royal/public-order frame is plausible but not certain.

proposal.literary_form: answer, tongue, eyes, healing speech, correction, and lips cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Gentle/grievous answer opens; tongue, YHWH's watching eyes, healing tongue, correction, and wise lips dominate to 15:7.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Each speech proverb alone would lose the answer/tongue/lips chain.
proposal.risk: Medium-high: 15:3 and 15:6 broaden the field.

proposal.literary_form: YHWH evaluation, correction, heart, and better-than household cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Sacrifice/prayer contrast opens; YHWH's pursuit and omniscience, correction, heart conditions, and two 'better than' household sayings culminate in love over feast.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating the better-than sayings would detach them from the interior/YHWH evaluation sequence.
proposal.risk: High: multiple mini-clusters may justify smaller units.

proposal.literary_form: conflict, path, counsel, joy, and upward-life cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Wrathful versus patient conflict opens; sluggard/upright ways, wise/foolish child, counsel, apt answer, and upward life-path close the sequence.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A seam after conflict would miss the continuing path/counsel response theme.
proposal.risk: High: catchword linkage is modest.

proposal.literary_form: YHWH's reversal, speech, teachability, and fear-humility closure cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: YHWH tears down/establishes opens; thought/word, unjust gain, listening, correction, fear of YHWH, and humility-before-honor provide a collection cadence.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Ending on chapter number alone is rejected; the fear/humility instruction closure is the positive basis.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: a wisdom-instruction cadence supports the seam, but the named collection continues.

proposal.literary_form: human plans under YHWH's ordering cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Repeated human heart/answer/work/way language is answered by YHWH's weighing, purpose, atonement, peace, and direction of steps.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One-verse segmentation would erase the dense human-plan/YHWH-response chain.
proposal.risk: Medium: exact start may include 15:33 as a thematic preface.

proposal.literary_form: royal judgment and favor cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Divine sentence on a king's lips opens; just measures, royal abhorrence of wickedness, righteous speech, wrath, favor, and rain-cloud life form a compact royal sequence.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating each royal saying would lose the court sequence.
proposal.risk: Low-medium: concentrated king vocabulary provides a strong cluster.

proposal.literary_form: wisdom, humility, path, heart, and gracious-speech cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Acquiring wisdom opens; upright path, pride/humility, word-heeding, wise heart, and pleasant words culminate in honeycomb healing.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Extracting 16:18 or 16:24 would detach memorable sayings from the wisdom-word chain.
proposal.risk: High: path and speech motifs overlap but do not fix an exact seam.

proposal.literary_form: deceptive way, destructive speech, violence, age, self-rule, and lot cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: The repeated way-seeming-right opens; appetite, troublemaking speech, violence, gray hair, self-control, and the lot move from human drives to governed outcome.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A chapter seam without the final lot/YHWH outcome would be arbitrary; 16:33 provides cadence.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: strong opening echo and closing providential cadence coexist with loose internal adjacency.

proposal.literary_form: household peace, testing, shame, evil speech, poor, and family honor cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Quiet household contrast opens; servant/son inheritance, YHWH heart-testing, listening, mocking poor, and grandchildren/parents keep household and honor in view.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating 17:6 would remove the explicit family-honor closure.
proposal.risk: High: verses 3-5 broaden beyond household.

proposal.literary_form: speech, gift, offense, correction, folly, and quarrel cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Unfitting speech opens; bribe/gift, covering offense, rebuke, rebellion, fool encounter, evil return, and breached-water quarrel culminate in conflict avoidance.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 17:14 would detach the quarrel warning from the offense/rebellion escalation.
proposal.risk: High: the gift sayings may constitute a separate pair.

proposal.literary_form: perverted judgment, friendship, surety, heart, and crooked speech cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Justifying wicked/condemning righteous opens; friend/brother and surety relations lead to conflict-loving and crooked-heart/tongue consequences.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One-verse units would hide the social-relation and perversion sequence.
proposal.risk: High: adjacency is more evident than formal unity.

proposal.literary_form: foolish child, heart, punishment, bribe, wisdom-focus, and restrained speech cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Foolish-child grief opens and returns at 17:25; heart/medicine, unjust punishment, bribe, understanding, and silence culminate in the fool-seems-wise speech closure.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Ending at the chapter number is supported only by the child inclusio and restrained-speech closure, not numbering.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: the child/fool frame is positive but the interior is mixed.

proposal.literary_form: isolation, fool's speech, judgment, deep words, quarrel, and gossip cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Self-separation and rejected wisdom open; fool mouth/lips repeatedly produce strife and ruin, ending with gossip entering inward parts.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One proverb per unit would erase the mouth/lips/words escalation.
proposal.risk: Medium-high: 18:4 offers a positive wisdom-word counterpoint.

proposal.literary_form: slackness, refuge, wealth, and pride/humility cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Slack worker/destructor comparison opens; YHWH's strong tower contrasts with imagined wealth refuge, followed by pride-before-destruction and humility-before-honor.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating refuge sayings from pride would miss false versus secure elevation.
proposal.risk: High: a compact interpretive cluster with no explicit formula.

proposal.literary_form: hearing, spirit, knowledge, dispute, gift, and speech-power cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Answer-before-hearing opens; wounded spirit, discerning ear, dispute procedure, gift, offended brother, and mouth fruit culminate in tongue's death/life.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 18:21 would detach the famous tongue saying from the hearing/dispute/speech sequence.
proposal.risk: Medium-high: gift and dispute verses broaden but remain communicative/social.

proposal.literary_form: compact relationship-and-companionship closure cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Finding a wife/favor opens; poor/rich speech and many companions versus a closer friend close on relational access and loyalty.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Single-verse relationship chunks would violate larger-unit preference.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: relational vocabulary links three sayings, but the cluster is weak.

proposal.literary_form: integrity, haste, anger, wealth, witness, and abandoned-poor cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Poor integrity versus crooked wealth opens; haste and self-ruin lead into wealth-created friends, false witness, gifts, and the poor person's abandoned kin/friends.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating wealth/friend sayings from poor-person frame would lose the social reversal.
proposal.risk: High: witness sayings interrupt the poverty/friend chain.

proposal.literary_form: wisdom, witness, restraint, royal response, household, and sloth cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Gaining wisdom opens; lying witness, fool luxury, discretion, king's wrath/favor, foolish son, wife, and deep sleep/sloth form governance of self and house.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A royal-only split at 19:12 would be too small and detach rule from household governance analogies.
proposal.risk: High: multiple plausible subclusters.

proposal.literary_form: commandment, mercy, discipline, counsel, desire, and fear-of-YHWH cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Keeping commandment/life opens; mercy to poor, child discipline, anger, listening/counsel, human plans versus YHWH purpose, kindness, and fear-of-YHWH life culminate in rest.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating child discipline would detach it from the broader teachability/counsel frame.
proposal.risk: High: linked by instruction and consequence more than catchword.

proposal.literary_form: sluggard, correction, shameful son, instruction, witness, and judgment cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Sluggard hand-in-dish image opens; striking/correcting, parental abuse, ceasing instruction, false witness, and judgments for scoffers close a discipline-resistant sequence.
proposal.rejected_alternative: The chapter seam is not sufficient; the closing judgment line supplies a positive cadence.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: resistance-to-instruction theme is plausible but not formal.

proposal.literary_form: wine, royal terror, strife, sloth, counsel, loyalty, and integrity cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Wine's mockery opens; king's terror and avoiding strife move to sloth, deep counsel, claimed loyalty, and the righteous person's intergenerational integrity.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Single sayings would hide the sober self-governance/integrity movement.
proposal.risk: High: exact cohesion is modest.

proposal.literary_form: royal judgment, purity, honest measures, child conduct, perception, and buyer speech cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: King on judgment throne opens; evil winnowing, purity question, unequal measures, child-known-by-deeds, seeing/hearing, sleep, and buyer speech concern discernment of claims.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating measure and buyer sayings would weaken the evaluation-of-claims motif.
proposal.risk: High: sleep proverb is a clear interruption.

proposal.literary_form: knowledge, surety, deceit, counsel, gossip, and inheritance cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Precious knowledge-lips open; surety pledge, deceptive food, counsel for plans/war, gossip, parent-cursing, and hastily gained inheritance evaluate unreliable gains and commitments.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One-verse chunks would lose the speech/commitment/gain sequence.
proposal.risk: High: thematic synthesis remains debatable.

proposal.literary_form: YHWH-directed justice, path, vows, kingship, spirit, loyalty, and discipline cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Do-not-repay/YHWH-wait opens; dishonest measures, directed steps, rash vows, king's winnowing, human spirit lamp, loyal throne, age honors, and cleansing blows close in discernment/judgment.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Chapter number alone is rejected; repeated evaluation/winnowing and discipline provide the positive closure.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: several judgment images cohere, but the unit is composite.

proposal.literary_form: king, YHWH evaluation, justice, pride, diligence, wealth, violence, and crooked way cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: King's heart in YHWH's hand opens; YHWH weighs hearts, justice outranks sacrifice, pride, diligent plans, lying treasure, robbery, and crooked/clean ways extend evaluated conduct.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting after the royal saying would isolate the governing evaluation frame.
proposal.risk: High: royal opening may stand alone.

proposal.literary_form: contentious household, wicked desire, justice, instruction, mercy, punishment, and wilderness contrast cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Better-than contentious-house saying opens and recurs at 21:19; between them wicked desire, justice, instruction, mercy, judgment, and pleasure are social-consequence contrasts.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating the two contentious-wife sayings would lose their envelope function.
proposal.risk: Medium: intervening aphorisms are diverse but the repeated better-than frame is strong.

proposal.literary_form: wise provision, righteousness, speech, sluggard desire, worship, witness, defiance, and YHWH-victory closure cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Wise treasure versus foolish consumption opens; pursuit, conquest, guarded speech, arrogant sluggard desire, sacrifice, witness, and human preparation culminate in victory belonging to YHWH.
proposal.rejected_alternative: The final victory line provides cadence; nevertheless a cross-chapter continuation remains possible.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: a strong terminal saying does not prove the preceding cluster's exact start.

proposal.literary_form: name, wealth/poverty, prudence, humility, path, and child training cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Good name versus riches opens; rich/poor maker, prudent refuge, humility/fear reward, crooked thorns, and training a child share durable path/reputation outcomes.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 22:6 would detach the path-training saying from adjacent path/outcome contrasts.
proposal.risk: High: famous-verse extraction is avoided, but the thematic seam is uncertain.

proposal.literary_form: rich-poor power, generosity, speech, purity, sloth, danger, discipline, and oppression collection closure
proposal.deciding_marker: Rich/borrower power opens; sowing injustice, generous eye, scoffer removal, purity/speech, YHWH guarding knowledge, sluggard excuse, dangerous mouth, discipline, and oppression close immediately before a new wise-sayings address.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Merging across 22:17 would swallow the explicit new addressee and 'words of the wise' invitation.
proposal.risk: Medium-high: inner cohesion is loose, but the endpoint is a strong named-collection seam.

proposal.literary_form: prologue to the words of the wise
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise' opens direct instruction; keeping them, trust, repeated writing, and reliable return-speech state the collection's purpose.
proposal.rejected_alternative: 22:17 alone would detach the invitation from its purpose and assurance.
proposal.risk: Low: explicit collection/addressee prologue.

proposal.literary_form: wise-sayings sequence on vulnerable neighbor, anger, surety, boundaries, and skilled service
proposal.deciding_marker: Robbing the poor opens a sequence of social/economic cautions; angry companion, surety, landmark, and skilled worker before kings close on relational and vocational positioning.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One saying per chunk would atomize the instruction collection; the whole named parent remains controlling alternative.
proposal.risk: High: distinct mini-instructions are grouped by social-economic function.

proposal.literary_form: appetite, wealth, stingy host, fool, landmark, and discipline instruction sequence
proposal.deciding_marker: Dining before a ruler opens appetite restraint; fleeting wealth and deceptive hospitality lead to speech restraint, protected boundaries, and applying heart to instruction.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Chapter-sized segmentation is rejected; the unit is a chain of self-restraint instructions ending in explicit discipline.
proposal.risk: High: several complete sayings could support smaller chunks.

proposal.literary_form: parental discipline and appeal for the son's heart amid envy, excess, and sexual danger
proposal.deciding_marker: Child discipline opens; repeated 'my son,' parental rejoicing, sinner-envy restraint, glutton/drunk warning, honoring parents, and 'give me your heart' culminate in the dangerous-woman pit/robber image.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating 23:22-25 or 23:26-28 would fragment the sustained parent/son appeal.
proposal.risk: Medium: 23:13-14 may close a prior discipline theme, but repeated son/parent language supports the larger unit.

proposal.literary_form: extended wine riddle, observation, and warning
proposal.deciding_marker: Six 'who has' questions open; wine observation, sensory attraction, serpent consequence, distorted perception, and the drinker's final quoted resolve form a complete vignette.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Breaking at 23:31 would detach observation from consequences and compulsive closure.
proposal.risk: Low: formal question catalogue and narrative consequence.

proposal.literary_form: wisdom, house-building, counsel, folly, adversity, and rescue instruction sequence
proposal.deciding_marker: Do not envy evil people opens; wisdom builds/fills a house and strengthens war counsel, contrasted with fool/schemer, then tested by adversity and rescue responsibility before the heart-weighing YHWH.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One saying per unit would obscure the escalating wisdom-in-action test.
proposal.risk: High: rescue instruction may begin a distinct unit.

proposal.literary_form: honey-wisdom analogy followed by restraints concerning righteous, enemy, evildoer, YHWH, and king
proposal.deciding_marker: Honey's goodness opens an explicit wisdom analogy with future hope; prohibitions against ambush, gloating, fretting, and rebellion culminate in sudden calamity from YHWH and king.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Merging 24:23 onward would ignore the new 'also these are sayings of the wise' superscription.
proposal.risk: Medium: multiple admonitions, but a hard endpoint and future/consequence thread.

proposal.literary_form: additional wise sayings on judgment, truthful response, ordered work, witness, and retaliation
proposal.deciding_marker: 'These also are sayings of the wise' opens a named supplement; partial judgment, rebuke blessing, honest kiss, work/house ordering, false witness, and anti-retaliation instructions form civic-neighbor conduct.
proposal.rejected_alternative: 24:23 alone would isolate the superscription, while including the field scene would blur its distinct observation frame.
proposal.risk: Medium: 24:27 is vocational rather than judicial but remains ordered-neighbor conduct.

proposal.literary_form: first-person sluggard-field observation and lesson
proposal.deciding_marker: 'I went by the field' introduces a first-person scene; observed neglect, reflective seeing, and repeated sleep/poverty conclusion form a self-contained vignette.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating the final poverty saying would detach the lesson learned from the observed field.
proposal.risk: Low: scene and explicit reflection close the supplement.

proposal.literary_form: Hezekiah-copy superscription with opening royal-court instruction
proposal.deciding_marker: The explicit copied-Solomon superscription opens a new collection; divine concealment/royal searching, removal of wicked court influence, and self-lowering before a king close at the court displacement warning.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Prov.25.1 alone would isolate the title; ending on chapter number would be irrelevant because the unit closes at royal audience conduct.
proposal.risk: Low-medium: clear collection opening and concentrated royal vocabulary.

proposal.literary_form: dispute, confidentiality, apt speech, faithful messenger, false gift, and patient persuasion cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Do-not-rush-to-court opens; private dispute handling, fitting words, faithful messenger, false boasting, and patient tongue all concern responsible communication in contested relations.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One image per chunk would obscure the dispute-to-persuasion communication chain.
proposal.risk: Medium: messenger and gift images broaden the legal frame.

proposal.literary_form: restraint in appetite, neighbor access, witness, unreliable trust, inappropriate song, and enemy care cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Honey moderation opens; restrained neighbor visiting, false witness, bad-tooth trust, song to sorrow, and feeding an enemy develop fitting versus harmful response.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Isolating enemy-care sayings would detach them from the sequence of proportionate conduct.
proposal.risk: High: the sequence is linked by appropriateness more than repeated vocabulary.

proposal.literary_form: social provocation and self-restraint closing cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Wind/rain and secret tongue open; contentious-house contrast, good news/cold water, compromised righteous spring, excess honey/honor, and wall-less self-control close the sequence.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A chapter-sized fallback is rejected; the wall-less-city self-rule image provides the positive cadence.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: the social/self-restraint theme is loose.

proposal.literary_form: extended fool catalogue
proposal.deciding_marker: Repeated 'fool' vocabulary governs honor, curse, rod, answer/no-answer paradox, messenger, proverb, and self-estimation, culminating in the person wise in own eyes as worse than a fool.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting 26:4-5 would destroy the deliberate paired tension; individual fool sayings belong to the catalogue.
proposal.risk: Medium: literary grouping does not harmonize the answer/no-answer pair.

proposal.literary_form: sluggard caricature catalogue
proposal.deciding_marker: The lion excuse introduces four consecutive sluggard images: door/bed turning, hand in dish, and self-estimated wisdom.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One image per unit would atomize a named-character catalogue.
proposal.risk: Low: four consecutive sluggard sayings.

proposal.literary_form: meddling, deception, quarrel, gossip, hatred, and flattering-mouth catalogue
proposal.deciding_marker: Meddling in another's quarrel opens; madman's deceptive joke, fuel/fire gossip, disguised hatred, pit/stone reversal, and lying/flattering mouth form escalating destructive speech.
proposal.rejected_alternative: The chapter seam is not the basis; repeated quarrel/gossip/lying-mouth vocabulary supplies the closure.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk is mitigated by an unusually dense destructive-speech chain.

proposal.literary_form: boasting, rebuke, provocation, jealousy, and loyal-friendship cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Do-not-boast opens; praise, fool's provocation, jealousy, open rebuke, faithful wounds, appetite, wandering, perfume/counsel, and enduring friend/neighbor loyalty culminate in near-neighbor preference.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Extracting friendship aphorisms would remove their contrast with praise, rebuke, and provocation.
proposal.risk: High: appetite and wandering images loosen the friendship frame.

proposal.literary_form: wise son, prudence, surety, contentious housemate, friendship sharpening, stewardship, appetite, heart, and refining cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: 'My son, be wise' opens; prudent refuge and relational/household images lead through sharpening, stewardship, insatiable appetite, heart reflection, and praise-as-crucible to the fool who resists refining.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A one-verse treatment would erase repeated testing/knowing-character concerns.
proposal.risk: High: several independent sayings are conservatively kept under the collection parent.

proposal.literary_form: flock-and-household stewardship instruction
proposal.deciding_marker: Imperatives to know flock condition open; impermanent riches and crown yield to seasonal fodder, lamb/goat provision, and household/maidens support.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating resource-cycle lines would fragment one practical stewardship instruction.
proposal.risk: Low: sustained flock/economic cycle and household outcome.

proposal.literary_form: righteous courage, social order, Torah, poverty/wealth, integrity, and public rule cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Wicked flight/righteous boldness opens; national rulers, oppressive poor, Torah keeping, justice-seeking, usury, prayer, integrity, inheritance, and righteous triumph develop public moral order.
proposal.rejected_alternative: A chapter-sized unit is rejected, while isolated Torah or poverty verses would lose the governance sequence.
proposal.risk: High: public-order linkage is broad and exact endpoint disputed.

proposal.literary_form: confession, fear, oppressive rule, guilt, integrity, partiality, greed, rebuke, family, trust, generosity, and righteous-public reversal cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Conceal/confess sin opens; fear/hardening, bad ruler, bloodguilt, integrity, wealth/partiality, greed, rebuke, parental robbery, proud trust, poor generosity, and wicked/righteous public reversal close the chapter's second movement.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Chapter number alone is rejected; confession/exposure and wicked/righteous hiding/emergence form a broad reversal envelope.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: the reversal envelope is real but many internal clusters compete.

proposal.literary_form: resistance to correction, righteous rule, justice, speech conflict, and kingly care for poor cluster
proposal.deciding_marker: Repeated-reproof hardening opens; righteous/wicked rule, wisdom/shame, king by justice, flattery, snares, singing, poor-rights knowledge, mockers, fool/wise conflict, and king judging poor culminate in established throne.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting royal sayings from justice/poor sayings would weaken the rule-and-response sequence.
proposal.risk: High: speech-conflict sayings interrupt the governance chain.

proposal.literary_form: discipline, law/vision, servant, anger, speech haste, pride, complicity, fear, ruler, and justice collection closure
proposal.deciding_marker: Rod/reproof and child discipline open; wicked increase, no-vision/Torah, servant correction, anger, hasty speech, pride, theft complicity, fear of man, ruler-seeking, and righteous/wicked mutual abhorrence close the copied collection.
proposal.rejected_alternative: The chapter seam is not sufficient; the unit ends because 30:1 explicitly introduces Agur and a new speaker-text complex.
proposal.risk: Medium-high: endpoint is hard, internal cluster remains composite.

proposal.literary_form: Agur superscription, confession of limitation, questions, and word-of-God warning
proposal.deciding_marker: Agur's named superscription opens; first-person weariness/ignorance, ascent-and-creation questions, and tested-word refuge culminate in a prohibition on adding.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Prov.30.1 alone would isolate a textually pressured superscription from its speaker's confession.
proposal.risk: Medium: names/addressees and translation are difficult; no preferred reading is selected.

proposal.literary_form: two-request prayer for truth and daily sufficiency
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Two things I have asked' provides a number frame; removal of falsehood and neither poverty nor riches are motivated by paired denial/forgetting risks.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Splitting the two requests would violate the explicit number frame.
proposal.risk: Low: explicit petition and motive closure.

proposal.literary_form: servant caution followed by a fourfold corrupt-generation catalogue
proposal.deciding_marker: The servant/slander caution opens a social harm transition; four repeated 'generation' lines catalogue cursing, self-purity, pride, and devouring the poor.
proposal.rejected_alternative: 30:10 alone is not retained as a one-verse unit; it is conservatively joined to the social-abuse catalogue.
proposal.risk: High: 30:10 may be independent; larger-unit preference controls.

proposal.literary_form: three/four insatiable catalogue with filial-eye consequence
proposal.deciding_marker: Leech daughters introduce 'three...four' insatiables; Sheol, barren womb, dry earth, and fire lead to the eye that scorns parents being consumed by birds.
proposal.rejected_alternative: The eye saying is not isolated; it echoes devouring/unsated consequence while remaining a disputed attachment.
proposal.risk: High: 30:17 may close the generation catalogue instead.

proposal.literary_form: three/four wondrous ways catalogue with adulterous-woman analogy
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Three things...four' opens; eagle, serpent, ship, and man-with-maiden ways culminate in the adulterous woman's erased-trace comparison.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Separating 30:20 would detach the interpretive analogy from the four-way riddle.
proposal.risk: Medium: the analogy's semantic force is disputed, but its literary attachment is strong.

proposal.literary_form: three/four socially unbearable reversals catalogue
proposal.deciding_marker: 'For three things the earth trembles, and under four' governs servant, fool, unloved wife, and servant-girl reversals.
proposal.rejected_alternative: No member of the numbered list is split from its governing formula.
proposal.risk: Low: explicit numerical frame.

proposal.literary_form: four small-but-wise creatures catalogue
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Four things are little...but exceedingly wise' governs ants, hyraxes, locusts, and lizard, each with a functional observation.
proposal.rejected_alternative: One animal per chunk would atomize the explicit fourfold catalogue.
proposal.risk: Low: explicit number and evaluative frame.

proposal.literary_form: three/four stately walkers catalogue and closing anti-strife counsel
proposal.deciding_marker: 'Three things are stately...four' governs lion, greyhound, male goat, and king; the fool-exalting counsel and milk/nose/anger pressing analogies close Agur's sequence by restraining strife.
proposal.rejected_alternative: The final counsel is not isolated; it functions as closure after the stately display.
proposal.risk: T467 chapter-coincident risk: positive numbered form and strife closure exist, but 30:32-33 may be an independent saying.

proposal.literary_form: Lemuel superscription and maternal royal instruction
proposal.deciding_marker: The named Lemuel oracle/instruction from his mother opens; triple 'what, my son' appeal, warning about strength and wine, and imperatives to speak/judge for vulnerable people close at 31:9.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Prov.31.1 alone would detach the superscription from the maternal royal instruction; merging the acrostic would ignore a new alphabetic form.
proposal.risk: Medium: names and translation are pressured, but speaker/addressee and instruction closure are clear.

proposal.literary_form: alphabetic poem praising a capable/valiant woman
proposal.deciding_marker: The rhetorical 'who can find' opens a self-contained portrait; the Hebrew alphabetic sequence governs twenty-two verses and closes with public praise for the fruit of her hands.
proposal.rejected_alternative: Topical or one-verse subdivision would fragment the governing alphabetic poem.
proposal.risk: Low literary seam; Hebrew wording, gender/social interpretation, and alphabetic evidence remain non-authorizing.

hardest_seams_and_t467.issue: A chapter-coincident unit can look like fallback.
hardest_seams_and_t467.rationale: The single 'my son, if' protasis and coordinated deliverance results give positive syntax and closure; retain MEDIUM because smaller result movements remain plausible.
Vocative-to-consequence and frame-narrative-appeal arcs independently support the units; both stay MEDIUM and queued under T467.

hardest_seams_and_t467.issue: Aphoristic adjacency makes exact catchword cluster boundaries unusually unstable.
hardest_seams_and_t467.rationale: Every child row preserves the entire named Solomonic collection as an exact alternative; most seams are LOW, and no single verse is promoted as an outer unit.

hardest_seams_and_t467.issue: Individual sayings are formally complete, but atomization would destroy collection and instruction context.
hardest_seams_and_t467.rationale: Use multi-saying functional sequences, preserve 22:17-24:22 and 24:23-34 parents, and keep contested seams LOW.

hardest_seams_and_t467.issue: Fool/sluggard and friendship/royal clusters are strong in places, weak elsewhere.
hardest_seams_and_t467.rationale: Explicit catchword catalogues receive higher confidence; mixed clusters retain the copied-Solomon collection parent and LOW confidence.

hardest_seams_and_t467.issue: Superscription/addressee translation pressure and attachment of 30:10, 30:17, and 30:32-33.
hardest_seams_and_t467.rationale: No reading is selected; disputed attachments use larger units, LOW/MEDIUM confidence, and exact Agur parent alternatives.

hardest_seams_and_t467.issue: Chapter numbering could conceal the hard form seam at 31:10.
hardest_seams_and_t467.rationale: Lemuel's maternal royal instruction closes at 31:9; the twenty-two-line alphabetic poem begins at 31:10 and remains whole.

oversplit_premortem: Do not convert every antithetic bicolon or memorable proverb into an outer chunk.
Do not isolate superscriptions at 10:1, 24:23, 25:1, 30:1, or 31:1 from the units they introduce.
Do not extract Prov.3.5-6, 4:23, 22:6, 29:18, or other famous verses from their local instruction or collection context.
Do not split explicit three/four catalogues, the paired Prov.26:4-5 tension, or the Prov.31:10-31 alphabetic poem.
Do not let chapter numbers validate seams; every chapter-coincident row requires a stated local form or cadence and remains lowered where contested.
Do not let WEB headings or layout, Hebrew roots, parallelism labels, or later canonical reuse become boundary authority.

Proverbs collection and catchword-cluster literary specialist
Hebrew-to-English and Hebrew-to-LXX Proverbs textual/translation specialist
Ancient wisdom-instruction and numerical-saying form specialist
Qualified Second Temple and rabbinic reception specialist with explicit chronology labels
Canonical intertext specialist who treats reuse as evidence rather than seam authority
final_statement: This blind literary/collection proposal covers Prov.1.1-Prov.31.31 exactly once in 106 ordered multi-verse outer units. Named collections remain exact parent alternatives, aphoristic seams are predominantly LOW, chapter coincidence is never the deciding rationale, and no theological, textual, authorship, canon, or personification ruling is made.
